translationRepairs: Emperor Xuanzong had thirty sons. Empress Yuanxian of the Yang clan was the mother of Suzong. Consort Liu Hua bore the Fengtian Emperor Cong, the Jinggong Heir Apparent Wan, and Prince of Yi Lin. Consort Zhao Li bore the deposed Crown Prince Ying; Consort Qian, Prince of Di Yan; Lady Huangfu Deyi, Prince of E Yao; Lady Liu, Prince of Guang Ju. Empress Zhenshun Wu bore Prince Xia Ci Yi, Prince Huai'ai Min, Prince of Shou Mao, and Prince of Sheng Qi. Lady Gao bore Prince of Ying Li; Lady Guo Shunyi, Prince of Yong Lin; Lady Liu, Prince of Yan Bin; Lady Zhong, Prince of Ji Huan; Lady Lu, Prince of Xin Huang; Lady Yan, Prince of Yi Ni; Lady Wang, Prince of Chen Gui; Lady Chen, Prince of Feng Gong; Lady Zheng, Prince of Heng Zhen; Lady Wu Xianyi, Prince of Liang Xuan and Prince of Bian Aihuan Jin. The remaining seven princes died in early childhood.

Emperor Xuanzong had thirty sons. Empress Yuanxian of the Yang clan was the mother of Suzong. Consort Liu (Huafei) bore Cong, the Fengtian Emperor; Wan, the Jinggong Heir Apparent; and Sui, Prince of Yi. Consort Zhao (Lifei) bore the deposed Crown Prince Ying; Consort Qian, Yan, Prince of Di; Huangfu Deyi, Yao, Prince of E; Liu Cairen, Ju, Prince of Guang. Empress Zhenshun of the Wu clan bore Yi, Prince Dao of Xia; Min, Prince Ai of Huai; Mao, Prince of Shou; and Qi, Prince of Sheng. Gao Jieyu bore Jiao, Prince of Ying; Guo Shunyi, Lin, Prince of Yong; Liu Jieyu, Bin, Prince of Yan; Zhong Meiren, Huan, Prince of Ji; Lu Meiren, Huang, Prince of Xin; Yan Cairen, Pin, Prince of Yi; Wang Meiren, Gui, Prince of Chen; Chen Meiren, Gong, Prince of Feng; Zheng Cairen, Tian, Prince of Heng; Wu Xianyi, Xuan, Prince of Liang, and Jing, Prince Ai of Bian. The remaining seven princes died in early childhood.

Several names are misread: 儀王璲 is Sui (not Lin), 夏悼王一 is Yi, Prince Dao of Xia, 潁王璬 is Jiao, 義王玭 is Pin, 恆王瑱 is Tian, 汴哀王璥 is Jing, Prince Ai of Bian; 華妃/麗妃/才人/婕妤 etc. are ranks, and 劉才人 and 柳婕妤 are different women.
